dialogue.content: よろしくお願い致します
dialogue.English: Thank you for coming. I look forward to our session.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Thank you. I look forward to our session as well.

dialogue.content: 今日はどうしましたか？
dialogue.English: What brings you in today?

dialogue.content: 元彼のことが忘れられなくて、辛いです
dialogue.English: I can’t get over my ex-boyfriend, and it’s painful.

dialogue.content: それは辛いですね
dialogue.English: That sounds very painful.

dialogue.content: はい、忘れたいのに忘れられません
dialogue.English: Yes, I want to forget him, but I just can't.

dialogue.content: 一緒に考えていきたいので、もう少し分かりやすく聞かせて頂きたいのですが
dialogue.English: I'd like to work through this with you. Could you please tell me a little more about it?

dialogue.content: 分かりやすく、ですか
dialogue.English: More clearly, you mean?

dialogue.content: とにかく辛いんですはやく忘れてしまいたいのに、どうしても考えてしまいます
dialogue.English: It's just so painful. I want to forget him quickly, but I can't stop thinking about him.

dialogue.content: どうしたら忘れられるのでしょうか
dialogue.English: How can I forget him?

dialogue.content: そうですよね。
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 何年位お付き合いされたのですか、どうして、今離れているのですか
dialogue.English: How long were you together, and why are you apart now?

dialogue.content: 2年と少しです
dialogue.English: A little over two years.

dialogue.content: むこうの浮気が原因で別れました
dialogue.English: We broke up because he cheated on me.

dialogue.content: それはひどいですね
dialogue.English: That's terrible.

dialogue.content: 私も許せないです。
dialogue.English: I wouldn't be able to forgive that either.

dialogue.content: すごく傷つきました、
dialogue.English: I was really hurt.

dialogue.content: そうですよね
dialogue.English: Of course.

dialogue.content: はい、
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 忘れられないほど、素敵なかただたのですね
dialogue.English: He must have been so wonderful that you can’t forget him.

dialogue.content: 浮気が分かるまではそんなに悪い人ではなかったです
dialogue.English: He wasn't such a bad person until I found out he was cheating.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: もう何も信じられないし、本当に最低なのに、なんでこんなにも忘れられなくて辛い思いをしなければいけないのか…
dialogue.English: I feel like I can’t trust anything anymore, and even though he’s truly the worst, I don’t know why I can’t forget him and have to feel this much pain…

dialogue.content: はやくあんな最低な人のことなんて忘れてしまいたいです
dialogue.English: I just want to forget about such a terrible person as soon as possible.

dialogue.content: きっと素敵な貴方なら、本当にあなたのことを考えてくださる方がみつかるまで、何か趣味か何か熱中出来ることがあると、いいですね
dialogue.English: I'm sure someone as wonderful as you will find a person who truly cares for you. In the meantime, it might help to have a hobby or something you can immerse yourself in.

dialogue.content: そうですね、いつかは信じられるひとに出会いたいです
dialogue.English: You're right. I hope to meet someone I can trust someday.

dialogue.content: でも、今は仕事中も趣味をしていても思い出してしまうので、とても次を考える気分にはなれません
dialogue.English: But right now, I end up remembering him even at work or while doing my hobbies, so I'm not in the mood to think about the next one at all.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、今まで信じてお付き合いされてきたのですものね
dialogue.English: That's understandable. You've been in a relationship with him, trusting him all this time.

dialogue.content: はい…
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: 旅行とか、少しそこから離れてみて、気分転換されたらどうでしょう！
dialogue.English: How about taking a trip or something to get away for a bit and have a change of scenery?

dialogue.content: あなたがくよくよしているのは、似合わないと思います。
dialogue.English: I don't think dwelling on it suits you.

dialogue.content: そうですね、傷心旅行とかよく聞きますし、思い切って遠出するのもいいのかもしれないですね
dialogue.English: That's true. I often hear about taking a trip to heal a broken heart, so maybe boldly going somewhere far away would be a good idea.

dialogue.content: そうです。是非まえを向いて、
dialogue.English: Exactly. Please, try to look forward.

dialogue.content: きっと、にこにこして、明るいあなたは、とても魅力的かと思いますが
dialogue.English: I'm sure that the cheerful, smiling you is very charming.

dialogue.content: 1つ聞きたいことがあるんですけど、いいですか？
dialogue.English: There's one thing I'd like to ask, is that okay?

dialogue.content: はいどうぞ
dialogue.English: Yes, go ahead.

dialogue.content: 今、大好きな趣味をしている時でさえ、思い出して辛くなってしまうんです。旅行は趣味ほどではないので、もしまた思い出してしまったらどうしたらいいんでしょう？
dialogue.English: Right now, even when I’m doing my favorite hobby, I remember him and it hurts. Since travel isn’t as engaging as my hobby, what should I do if I end up thinking of him again?

dialogue.content: 悲しい思いをしながらの旅行になるのかもしれないと思ったら、旅行する勇気がちょっと出ないです…
dialogue.English: When I think it might turn into a trip filled with sadness, I don't quite have the courage to go...

dialogue.content: それほど、大好きなのか、頭に来ているのかどちらでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Is it that you love him that much, or that you’re that angry with him?

dialogue.content: うーん…
dialogue.English: Hmm...

dialogue.content: どっちもです酷いことされて怒りが湧きますでも、まだ彼のことを好きな自分がいる気がします
dialogue.English: It's both. I'm angry that he did such a terrible thing to me. But I feel like a part of me still loves him.

dialogue.content: どうして浮気されたのか、自分の何がいけなかったのか答えも分からないのによく考えてしまいます
dialogue.English: I keep thinking about why he cheated and what was wrong with me, even though I don’t have the answers.

dialogue.content: それなら、彼に今の思いを伝えてみては
dialogue.English: In that case, how about telling him how you feel now?

dialogue.content: もう会いたくないんです。浮気を許してしまうかもしれない自分が怖くて。連絡先も全部消してしまいました。
dialogue.English: I don't want to see him again. I'm afraid I might end up forgiving him for cheating. I've already deleted all his contact information.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: はい、浮気するような人と戻りたいとはさすがに思わないので…
dialogue.English: Yes, I really don't think I want to get back together with someone who would cheat...

dialogue.content: そうですよね、あまり考え過ぎると、身体と心がやんでしまっては、大変なので、
dialogue.English: I agree. If you overthink it too much, it could take a toll on your body and mind, which would be very difficult, so…

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: どうか、笑顔の素敵なあなたに戻ってほしいです
dialogue.English: I truly hope you can return to your wonderful, smiling self.

dialogue.content: はい…
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: それでは、サクラさんが、少しずつ明るく魅力的なサクラさんに戻れることを祈っていますね。
dialogue.English: Well then, Ms. Sakura, I'll be hoping that you can gradually return to being the bright and charming person you are.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: また、サクラさんにお会い出来ることを楽しみにしています。
dialogue.English: I look forward to seeing you again, Ms. Sakura.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you very much.

dialogue.content: サクラさんとの出会いを私も宝物にしていきますね。ありがとうございました。合掌
dialogue.English: I will treasure this encounter with you as well, Ms. Sakura. Thank you very much.
